<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_snc_airop_check_definition"><x_snc_airop_check_definition action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><ai_justification><![CDATA[CSM SLAs provide urgency signals Now Assist uses for AI-driven case prioritization.]]></ai_justification><check_name>CSM SLA Configuration</check_name><check_script><![CDATA[(function(checkDef, dateFilter) {
    var ga = new GlideAggregate('sla');
    ga.addQuery('table', 'CONTAINS', 'sn_customerservice');
    ga.addQuery('active', true);
    ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
    ga.query();
    var count = ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT')) : 0;

    var actualValue = count + ' active CSM SLA definitions';

    if (count >= 5) {
        return {
            status: 'ready',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: count + ' active CSM SLAs. Now Assist CSM can prioritize cases using AI-driven SLA breach risk analysis.'
        };
    } else if (count >= 1) {
        return {
            status: 'needs_attention',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: 'Only ' + count + ' active CSM SLA(s) (target: 5+). Now Assist CSM SLA-based AI prioritization will have limited differentiation across case types and customer tiers.'
        };
    } else {
        return {
            status: 'not_ready',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: 'No active CSM SLAs defined. Now Assist CSM cannot differentiate case urgency for AI prioritization without SLA definitions.'
        };
    }
})]]></check_script><is_active>true</is_active><is_clone_sensitive>false</is_clone_sensitive><is_manual>false</is_manual><module>CSM</module><number>CHK0001044</number><order>60</order><remediation_guidance>Configure CSM SLAs for each case type and customer tier.
